How do I book and pay?

Choose a plan or a single session, tell us your track and topic, pick up to two slots in IST and add your details. Then scan the UPI QR code or pay our UPI ID from any UPI app and enter the 12-digit UPI reference. Your booking is placed only after payment, and you get a booking page you can open any time to see its status.
My payment was deducted but I have no confirmation. What now?

If your payment went through, your session is booked. Please allow 2 to 4 hours during support hours for us to verify it and send your slot and room link. If it has been longer, or the payment failed, message us on WhatsApp with your booking ID and UPI reference, or raise a ticket on the contact page.

How does the video room work?

Every confirmed booking gets its own private room link, shown on your booking page and sent with your confirmation. Open it in your browser at the confirmed time; on a phone, the free Jitsi Meet or Google Meet app may ask to open. Voice sessions start with the camera off, and 90 minute sessions include screen sharing.

I am under 18. Can I book?
Yes, with a parent or guardian's consent. We ask for their name and mobile number during booking and confirm with them before the first session. Sessions stay one to one in a private room.

Your details go only to the QIVA team and your mentor, and to the service providers we need to run bookings and payments. There are no public profiles or shared feeds. The Privacy Policy explains your rights, including asking for a copy of your data or deleting it.
What kinds of mentorship do you offer?
Six tracks: career guidance, study doubts, motivation and mindset, startup and innovation, AI and tech skills, and communication and confidence. Every plan and session works for every track.
